_comment: 2026-07-26 (Task 2.3): the fixture's gate counter is now horns_dig_started -- ruin_door's door_when moved onto it, so this script keeps proving the REAL seam transition, just off the dig invitation instead of the retired door-chain start. The camp NPC it lights up is why the entity count went 9 -> 10; the route is untouched (the camp and its two new blocked dressing cells all sit on row y=3, which this walk never uses). Fixture rng_state (9) governs; no combat happens in this script at all, so no seed search was needed.
